name: v0.2.2
body:
Features

  - Permission setup wizard — First-launch onboarding wizard that guides users through granting Screen Recording, Microphone, Input Monitoring, and Accessibility permissions (#10)
  - Selective smart keyframe generation — Users can now choose which keyframe types to auto-generate instead of always generating all types (#16)
  - .screenize package format — Migrated project format from legacy .fsproj to .screenize macOS package (directory containing project.json + recording/ media folder)
  - Event stream pipeline (v4) — Added polyrecorder-compatible event stream models and writer with dual-write integration for future recording format support

  Bug Fixes

  - Window capture cursor positioning — Fixed mouse cursor position calculation for window-source captures
  - Multi-display cursor diagnostics — Improved window capture cursor tracking and diagnostic logging across multiple displays
  - Legacy project migration — Fixed opening legacy .fsproj projects to correctly use the migrated package URL
  - Finder double-click handling — Prevented duplicate windows when opening .screenize files via Finder double-click by routing through AppDelegate

name: v0.2.1
body:
New Features                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                            
  - Render settings preset system — Save, load, and delete render settings presets for quick reuse across projects          
  - Undo/redo system — Snapshot-based UndoStack for timeline editing, with undo/redo buttons added to the editor toolbar    
  - Keyboard shortcut help panel — Press Cmd+? or the per-page ? button to view context-aware keyboard shortcuts for the    
  current screen                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            
  Improvements                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                            
  - Removed timeline time display and track focus feature — Simplified the timeline UI by removing unused elements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/syi0808/screenize/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1

name: v0.2.0
body:
New Features                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                  
  - Custom background image picker — Added image picker in Settings Inspector to select custom background images for recordings   
  - Floating recording widget — Added a floating control panel that stays on screen during recording                              
  - Editor toolbar improvements — Added Home and New Recording buttons to the editor toolbar for easier navigation between screens
  - Home button on recording screen — Added Home button to the recording screen control bar                                       
  - Keyframe deletion shortcut — Selected keyframes can now be deleted with the Backspace/Delete key                              
                                                                                                                                  
Bug Fixes                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                  
  - Desktop wallpaper included in fullscreen recording — Fixed fullscreen recordings missing the desktop wallpaper background     
  - Window mode rendering — Window corner radius and shadow now scale proportionally with zoom level                              
  - Play button behavior — Play button now restarts from the beginning after playback ends

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/syi0808/screenize/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
